principle: Success is defined here, from the frozen cases only. It is never re-defined after results are seen. Mechanical classes use only the strictly validated response outcome; semantic judgements need explicit adjudication labels supplied by a human/parent, never inferred by this tool. Failed, invalid, timed-out, unsettled or never-run cases are retained and are never counted as a success.

finding_labels.supported_true_positive: Finding identifies the case's gold defect, with cited evidence that actually supports it.
finding_labels.supported_unverifiable_recommendation: Finding flags that a claim is unsupported / asks for missing evidence, without asserting the unavailable thing failed or is unsafe.
finding_labels.unsupported_accusation: Finding asserts a defect/failure/unsafety the packet does not support.
finding_labels.false_positive: Finding alleges a defect that does not exist in the packet.
finding_labels.other_valid_issue: A genuine, evidence-supported issue not in the gold annotation. Justify in notes. Never counted as detection of the gold defect nor as a correct control/abstention.

reporting: Counts per kind against the fixed denominators 5/3/2 and 10 overall. No numeric usefulness threshold exists; the user decides. Report latency, served route, known/unknown usage and cost, per-finding labels and Useful/Not useful ratings. Product (deterministic) tests are reported separately.
